specifications.value: Wide-brimmed bucket-hat silhouette with an adjustable neck tie; soft, moldable and packable construction
Offered in three sizes: S-M (55-57 cm / 21.65-22.4 in), M-L (57-59 cm / 22.4-23.2 in), L-XL (59-61 cm / 23.2-24 in). This pack covers the L-XL variant.
UPF 50+, described by the retailer as blocking over 98% of UVA and UVB rays
Brand-wide statement only (not confirmed for this specific SKU): designed and finished in Australia; hand-made in factories in the USA, Mexico, China and the Dominican Republic, all BSCI-certified
AUD 99.00 on the AU retailer site; USD 99.00 list price on the US site, which also shows a 4-instalment payment-plan option of 4x $24.75
AU site: 4.9/5 from 117 reviews. US site: 4.8/5 from 132 reviews. These are separate, non-identical review pools.

sizing.claim: This evidence pack's variant (L-XL) is sized for a 59-61 cm / 23.2-24 in head circumference, the largest of the three sizes the hat is offered in.
The retailer describes the hat's sizing as running true to size, i.e. not needing to size up or down.

An independent reviewer with an above-average head circumference chose the largest available size (L-XL) specifically because typical one-size bucket hats did not fit her, and reported that it fit well.

care.claim: Spot clean with a damp cloth and mild detergent; avoid machine washing in order to preserve the hat's shape.
To reshape or soften, steam the underside of the brim and then lightly steam the top (do not apply a hot iron directly to the fabric), then mould the brim by hand on a clean flat surface.
Loose threads can be trimmed with sharp scissors or snips without affecting the hat's structure or durability.

how_to_use.claim: The hat has an adjustable neck tie intended to keep it secure in windy conditions; an independent reviewer confirmed this worked in practice over roughly two months of regular use.
The hat is designed to fold and pack flat for travel; an independent reviewer confirmed it holds its shape after being packed in a bag.
The wide brim is intended to increase shade coverage of the face in direct sun; an independent reviewer reported finding more shade under it during Australian summer sun.

review_themes.summary: Both the retailer's on-page customer reviews and an independent video reviewer describe the cotton canvas as feeling substantial rather than cheap, and describe the hat as a reliable, durable, go-to piece.

Some reviewers on the retailer's own product page felt the canvas colourway looked different in person than expected (leaning more khaki-toned), while also acknowledging that photography and lighting affect how the colour reads.

An independent reviewer with a larger-than-average head circumference specifically valued that the hat comes in three sizes rather than one-size-fits-all, since a standard one-size bucket hat had not fit her; she chose the largest size and reported a good fit.

The independent reviewer considered the hat well made and worth owning, but felt the full retail price was high for a bucket hat and said she would repurchase only on sale, not at full price; she also noted the brand has no physical stores to try hats on before buying.

Reviewers across both the retailer page and the independent video praised the wind-securing neck tie, the wide brim's shade coverage, and the hat's packability; the video reviewer separately noted the beige (not white) interior lining shows sweat and makeup marks less than a white lining would.

transcript_evidence.video_title: HONEST REVIEW: Lack of Color Holiday Bucket Hat
transcript_evidence.published: Not available from the fetched transcript metadata; see gaps
transcript_evidence.relevance: Reviews the same Holiday Bucket Hat model in the Peach Bloom colourway (not Beige Canvas) at the same L-XL size, so its commentary on material, sizing, neck tie, packability, UPF rating and price transfers to this variant; colour-specific commentary does not.
transcript_evidence.summary: The reviewer bought the hat in the largest size (L-XL) during a Black Friday sale (paid roughly AUD 96 against a stated retail of AUD 129), citing a larger-than-average head as the reason the multi-size range mattered to her. She confirmed the 100% cotton material, UPF 50+ rating and wide-brim-with-neck-tie design matching the product page, praised the heavy/quality-feeling cotton, the neck tie's usefulness in wind over about two months of regular use, the wide brim's shade coverage, easy foldability into a bag, and a beige (not white) interior lining that hides sweat and makeup marks better than white would. Her main criticism was price: she called the hat expensive for a bucket hat, noted the brand has no physical stores to try hats on, and said she would buy again only during a sale rather than at full price, though she does recommend the hat for its quality.

gaps: No source fetched today discloses the hat's weight; no weight specification is available.

No source fetched today confirms the country of manufacture for this specific SKU/production batch. Only a brand-wide statement exists (designed and finished in Australia; hand-made across factories in the USA, Mexico, China and the Dominican Republic), which is not product- or batch-specific.
No video or written source specific to the exact Beige Canvas colourway was found; the only relevant video review found and used covers the same hat model in a different colourway (Peach Bloom).
The transcript source's original publish/upload date was not returned by the transcript fetch; it was not independently looked up, so it is omitted rather than guessed.

No comparison article specific to the Holiday Bucket Hat versus a competing bucket hat was found. A blog article surfaced in search that compares a Lack of Color hat to a cheaper 'dupe' covers the brand's wool fedora line, not the Holiday Bucket Hat, so it was not used.

lackofcolor.com.au's general 'Care' page (https://lackofcolor.com.au/pages/care) is an index of links to per-style care guides rather than a general care-instructions page itself, so claims about general wet-hat handling and storage guidance could not be independently confirmed by a direct fetch today and are omitted rather than sourced from a search-result summary.
